propositions: Parallel multi-session writes cause compaction to mutate worktree before git commit with no rollback on worker death, leaving dirty tree and stranding local ticket commits off origin.
Sync merge aborts on untracked files origin wants to create OR tracked-file deletions/modifications, breaking plan-review/close attestation due to strict git status checks.
Runtime markers `*/.archived` and `*/.write.lock` are tracked in HEAD and never un-tracked, causing routine marker churn to perpetually show as tracked dirt.
Compaction fold must be crash-atomic with intent journal sentinel outside worktree, recovery preamble to revert abandoned partial folds, and no dirty state production.
Sync reconverge and push recovery paths must handle both untracked-collision and tracked-deletion abort variants with quarantine and restoration.
Store-wide scans (fsck, compact-all) must default to active tickets only and accept --include-archived flag to reach full store, scoping cost to active working set.
